checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, ears, muzzle, coat and pose match closely; the dog is almost identical in all three.

must.item: Locations are beach, snowy forest trail, cosy living room
must.why: Each setting is clear: beach with sea and sand, snowy pines with a trail, living room with sofas, lamp and rug.

must.item: Dog naturally integrated with plausible scale, lighting, contact
must.why: Scale and contact are plausible, with shadows on the sand. The pose is identical in every image, so it looks pasted. The snow has little shadow and the living room dog looks slightly flat.
No clothing or text is visible.

faults.what: The pose, framing and camera angle are identical in all three, so the dog looks cut out and pasted onto the backgrounds.
The dog's lighting is slightly mismatched in the snow and living room images. The snow image has weak ground shadow.
The tail is blended into the rug in the living room image.

summary: Three clean, square images show the same dog in the requested settings with no clothes or text; the only real weakness is the repeated, slightly pasted-in pose.
